name: cloudsearchdomain
description: You use the AmazonCloudSearch2013 API to upload documents to a search domain and search those documents.

subcommands.name: search
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of documents that match the specified search criteria.

options.name: --cursor
options.description: Retrieves a cursor value you can use to page through large result sets.

options.name: --expr
options.description: Defines one or more numeric expressions that can be used to sort results or specify search or filter criteria.

options.name: --facet
options.description: Specifies one or more fields for which to get facet information, and options that control how the facet information is returned.

options.name: --filter-query
options.description: Specifies a structured query that filters the results of a search without affecting how the results are scored and sorted.

options.name: --highlight
options.description: Retrieves highlights for matches in the specified text or text-array fields.

options.name: --partial
options.description: Enables partial results to be returned if one or more index partitions are unavailable.

options.name: --no-partial
options.description: Enables partial results to be returned if one or more index partitions are unavailable.

options.name: --query-options
options.description: Configures options for the query parser specified in the queryParser parameter.

options.name: --query-parser
options.description: Specifies which query parser to use to process the request.

options.name: --return
options.description: Specifies the field and expression values to include in the response.

options.name: --size
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of search hits to include in the response

options.name: --sort
options.description: Specifies the fields or custom expressions to use to sort the search results.

options.name: --start
options.description: Specifies the offset of the first search hit you want to return.

options.name: --stats
options.description: Specifies one or more fields for which to get statistics information.

options.name: --search-query
options.description: Specifies the search criteria for the request.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: suggest
subcommands.description: Retrieves autocomplete suggestions for a partial query string.

options.name: --suggester
options.description: Specifies the name of the suggester to use to find suggested matches

options.name: --size
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of suggestions to return

options.name: --suggest-query
options.description: Specifies the string for which you want to get suggestions

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: upload-documents
subcommands.description: Posts a batch of documents to a search domain for indexing.

options.name: --documents
options.description: A batch of documents formatted in JSON or HTML

options.name: --content-type
options.description: The format of the batch you are uploading.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
